points.title: Circle to Search
points.text: Home button ya neeche wali line ko long-press karo. Screen par AI search khul jayega.

points.title: Gol ghero, jawab pao
points.text: Kisi bhi photo, text ya video par gola banao aur turant search karo.

points.title: Gaana pehchano
points.text: Music icon dabao, aas-paas baj raha gaana pehchan lega.

takeaway: App badalne ki zarurat nahi, ek long-press kaafi hai.
